correctness.rationale: On the isotropic quadratic the gradient equals the parameter matrix. Strict diagonal ordering makes each refreshed top singular subspace unique. The unit projected step kills exactly that block, after which projector reuse yields an exactly zero compact gradient for the next refresh interval. Induction gives the first zero iterate at the claimed time, and the embedded checker replays the recurrence.

value.rationale: Refresh frequency is a defining GaLore hyperparameter balancing SVD cost against tracking a changing gradient subspace. The theorem isolates its worst-case cost without curvature or noise: a projector can go from exactly optimal to completely blind after one step and remain blind for the rest of the block. The exact staircase is a structural diagnostic for refresh-policy design rather than a routine recomputation.
